title: Show that one positive entry cancels only one length-9 rim direction
body:
## Summary
- On the length-9 width-1 cycle, flipping one neighbor entry and deleting the opposite vertex leaves both rim entries at `-1/16`. Every directed neighbor sign flip keeps the touching bandwidth.
- The one-vertex fill is `1/16`. One positive entry of that size zeros one Schur direction and leaves the other at `-1/16`, so the bandwidth stays 2. Both directions drop it to 1, below the touching diameter.
- The selected κ is unchanged.
